cat << 'EOF' > /work/debug_chair_feet3.py
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

im26 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0026.png'))
brown_mask = (im26[:,:,0] > 70) & (im26[:,:,1] > 30) & (im26[:,:,1] < 100) & (im26[:,:,2] < 50)
print("max v overall:", np.argwhere(brown_mask)[:,0].max())

# Let's see bottom of each column u in [230, 340]
bottoms = {}
for u in range(230, 340):
    rows = np.argwhere(brown_mask[:, u])
    if len(rows) > 0:
        bottoms[u] = rows.max()

# Plot local maxima of bottoms
import scipy.signal as sig
u_vals = list(bottoms.keys())
v_vals = [bottoms[u] for u in u_vals]
for u, v in zip(u_vals, v_vals):
    if u in [243, 271, 286, 319]:
        print(f"u={u}: v={v}")

# Find local maxima in v_vals:
peaks, _ = sig.find_peaks(v_vals, distance=10)
for p in peaks:
    print(f"Peak at u={u_vals[p]}, v={v_vals[p]}")

EOF
